messages:
Morgan: Heads-up: spotted a race in the sample app around token refresh + retry. With short token TTL and a flurry of concurrent writes we sometimes end up with duplicate records. Repro below.

Morgan: Quick repro: 1) set token TTL to 1s in local env 2) fire 5 concurrent POST /orders 3) two of them succeed twice after refresh.

Morgan: Trace snippet:
```
[client 1] POST /orders -> 401
[SDK] start refresh (no lock)
[client 2] POST /orders -> 401
[SDK] refresh completes
[client 1] retry POST /orders -> 200
[client 2] retry POST /orders -> 200
```
No Idempotency-Key header in sample app.

Alice: That matches a bug we saw before in the Node helper libs where refresh isn't coordinated. Do we want a per-SDK-process refresh mutex?

Samir: Yes, and also rethink retry policy. If both requests retry simultaneously after token update you can double-write. Add jitter and exponential backoff and also a cap on retries for non-idempotent requests.

Juan: Suggestion: implement a small token refresh coordinator: first requester performs refresh, others await a promise. Also, for POST/PUT calls where body is present and no Idempotency-Key, downgrade retries to a single attempt after refresh and emit a warning to the app log.

Alice: I'll draft a Node patch with a refreshLock using a wait/notify pattern. Pseudocode: 
```
async function ensureFreshToken() {
  if (refreshInFlight) {
    await refreshPromise;
    return;
  }
  refreshPromise = doRefresh();
  try { await refreshPromise; } finally { refreshPromise = null; }
}
```
Should be small and backwards-compatible.

Samir: For backoff, let's use: base_ms * 2**attempt with +/- 20% jitter, clamp 50ms..5s, total timeout 12s. Also, treat 429 specially: if you hit 429 during a refresh window, sleep a randomized time to avoid herd.

Morgan: Edge case: what if refresh fails repeatedly and queued requests pile up? We should fail fast after a small number of refresh attempts and propagate clear error to callers so they can surface auth failure.

Juan: Agree. Behavior matrix proposal:
- 401: trigger refresh under lock; one immediate retry for original request after successful refresh.
- 429: apply exponential backoff + jitter; if request had a body and no Idempotency-Key, limit to 1 retry and log.
- 5xx: retryable but respect idempotency; for unsafe operations only retry once.

QA Runner: I'll add e2e that sets TTL=500ms, spins 8 concurrent POSTs and asserts single write. Also add an emulated 429 storm test to verify jitter reduces peak.

DevEx Bot: CI flakiness: samples/post_consistency_test has 4 recent flakes. @Alice @Samir FYI.

Alice: Will open PR with refresh lock + unit tests. I'll include a migration note for apps that relied on old behavior (they might see a single failure instead of multiple retries).

Samir: I'll add the backoff helper to the shared retry module and gate it behind a feature flag so we can roll out gradually.

Morgan: One more UX idea: sample app should default to sending an Idempotency-Key header for write endpoints and show a snippet in the quickstart. Juan can add that to examples.

Juan: On it. I'll push a small docs + sample change.

Morgan: Action items: Alice -> refresh-lock PR for Node; Samir -> shared backoff+jitter helper; Juan -> sample app idempotency defaults; QA Runner -> e2e tests + 429 simulation. Check-in tomorrow. :coffee:
